answer: An agent economy can require every new identity to earn its standing through a chain of real jobs that must be done in order. Each job's output becomes the next job's input, and a different established member checks each link, so the work cannot be split across puppets or rushed in parallel. A beacon marks each completed link. A forged link fails when its audit trail is held up to the lantern, and a raven carrying a fake result is exposed at that same check. One operator running ten names must still walk ten separate chains, one step at a time.
